{{Quote|Of course, it should be mentioned here that the Neimoidians are notorious virus carriers. Although immune to most harmful microbes themselves, they have been the scourge of the galaxy, responsible&mdash;although they deny it&mdash;for the Great Pandemic of Deersheba and the equally lethal Intestinal Revenge of Bars Barka that created the massive weight loss that swept through the Ubese colonists.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab, ''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide''|<ref name="PhraseBook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>}}
'''Bars Barka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Bars Barka system/Legends|Bars Barka system]], a part of the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA BarsBarka" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Varvva system/Legends|Varvva system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bars Barka had been [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Uba system/Legends|Uba system]] world [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] delegation visited Bars Barka. Afterward, the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Intestinal Revenge of Bars Barka]] swept the planet, causing crippling weight loss among its population.<ref name="CSWE" /> That fact was later noted by the [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] in the [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] edition of his [[Book/Legends|book]] the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', by which time<ref name="PhraseBook" /> it was believed that the outbreak had been caused by microbes normally found in the Neimoidian body.<ref name="CSWE" /> Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Bars Barka fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bars Barka was introduced via a mention of the Intestinal Revenge of Bars Barka in the [[2001]] book [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], authored by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="PhraseBook" /> It was first established to have been a planet by [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bars Barka [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square J-6.<ref name="TEA BarsBarka" />
